title: Q-CLONE-adopt-own-repo: A copied template run on the platform keeps its own repository
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** grep:site/graduate.js::adopt_repo
**Status:** open

CLONE-PATH-1: a person who copied the template and has no hosting sign-in gets one link (`https://ultrastable.io/start?idea=...`, card GATE-RUNTIME in seed/bootstrap/bootstrap.py) that runs the system on the platform's account. The front door then gives the app a new `app-*` repository; the person's own copy is left beside it. Carry the copy's `owner/name` on the link, verify it by reading its `IDEA.md` (same idea text, public repository), record it on the launch as `adopt_repo` and make the app's work items land there instead of creating a second repository.

size: M

**Closing probe:** node --test site/launchpath.test.mjs has a story where a launch that names a copied template ends with that repository as the app's home.
